_comment: Self-serve sponsor slots. `active` is written by the sponsor-intake workflow from approved GitHub issues labelled 'sponsor-live' — you do not edit it by hand. Set `buy_url` to a payment link (Stripe Payment Link / Lemon Squeezy / Ko-fi) whose success page tells the buyer to open a sponsor issue. `auto_approve` renders a paid slot the moment its issue is labelled paid, no human review.
